coi.name: California Oregon Intertie
coi.source_text: BPA path file, 15 minute averages of 2 second SCADA, period ending in Pacific time; hourly values are the average of four intervals.
coi.evidence: Equals EIA BPAT to CISO plus BPAT to BANC within 12 MW every hour of Oct 7, 2026 (PDCI out). BPA timestamps are period ending in Pacific prevailing time: hourly COI matched EIA BPAT to CISO plus BANC (UTC hour ending) within 12 MW on Oct 7, 2026.

pdci.name: Pacific DC Intertie
pdci.note: Sign from the TTC column labels (N-S positive). Flow and limits were 0 MW from Oct 3 to Oct 12, 2026; CAISO NOB_ITC hourly limit was also 0 MW on Oct 7.
pdci.source_text: BPA path file, 15 minute averages of 2 second SCADA, period ending in Pacific time; hourly values are the average of four intervals.

path3.name: Northwest to British Columbia
path3.note: BPA file BC Intertie (West+East). The live figure is BC Hydro BC-US until the BPA daily file posts.
path3.source_text: BPA path file, 15 minute averages of 2 second SCADA, period ending in Pacific time; hourly values are the average of four intervals.
path3.evidence: BPA value equals EIA BPAT to BCHA (BPA outflow positive), correlation 1.000 and mean difference 0 MW over 49 hours, Oct 7 to 8, 2026.
path3.alt_name: BC Hydro BC to US actual

path8.name: Montana to Northwest
path8.source_text: BPA path file, 15 minute averages of 2 second SCADA, period ending in Pacific time; hourly values are the average of four intervals.
path8.evidence: BPA value tracks EIA BPAT plus AVA to NWMT (outflow to Montana positive), correlation 1.000, mean difference 27 MW, Oct 7 to 8, 2026.

path14.name: Idaho to Northwest
path14.note: Rating is 2,400 MW east to west in winter and 2,300 MW in other seasons. No limit series in the BPA file.

path14.evidence: Idaho Power point; tracks EIA IPCO to BPAT plus PACW plus AVA (Idaho outflow positive), correlation 0.999, Oct 7 to 8, 2026.

path76.name: Alturas Project (Reno to Alturas)
path76.note: Rating from the WECC 2026 Path Rating Catalog.
path76.source_text: BPA path file, 15 minute averages of 2 second SCADA, period ending in Pacific time; hourly values are the average of four intervals.
path76.evidence: BPA value equals minus EIA BPAT to NEVP (correlation -1.000, mean sum 0 MW), so BPA positive is south to north. BPA notes the sign changed on Feb 23, 2017.

path1.name: Alberta to British Columbia
path1.note: Metered flow from BC Hydro (5 minute). Limits are the AESO intertie TTCs. AESO snapshots are a cross check once the live job runs.
path1.source_text: BC Hydro actual flow page, 5 minute values in Pacific time, taken as period ending; 15 minute and hourly values average every interval in them. Limits are the AESO intertie TTCs (import into and export out of Alberta).
path1.evidence: BC Hydro BC-AB is positive from BC to Alberta: it equals minus AESO British Columbia actual_flow within 27 MW at 22:15Z and 22:35Z on Oct 12, 2026 (2 and 27 MW). BC Hydro timestamps are Pacific prevailing time: the page fetched at 22:39Z on Oct 12, 2026 (15:39 PDT) was posted at 15:35 and its last row was 15:35. Each 5 minute value is taken as the interval ending at its timestamp; this is assumed, because the BPA comparison fits ending and beginning equally well at 5 minutes.

matl.name: Montana Alberta Tie Line
matl.note: Flow comes only from AESO snapshots taken by the live job; days before it have limits only.
matl.source_text: AESO current supply and demand snapshots, taken by the live job only. Limits are the AESO intertie TTCs (import into and export out of Alberta).
matl.evidence: AESO actual_flow is positive for export out of Alberta: alberta_internal_load equals total_net_generation minus net_actual_interchange, and net_actual_interchange equals the sum of the three paths, in 6 of 6 snapshots on Oct 12, 2026.
